side.heading: Why it drops
side.body:
Cycle 1 carries the box cost. After that the brand pays only pickup and cleaning.

Break-even at cycle 3 assumes a 6% loss rate, measured at 4.1% in the pilot.

slides.callout: At 10 cycles a Loopwell order costs half of a single-use box.
